title: The 808's kick against the 909's

params.note: Both sides play the same original four-on-the-floor pattern at the same tempo, so the only thing that changes is the machine. Synthesized with SQUELCH's 808 and 909 worklets.

caption: Same beat, same speed, two Roland drum machines: only the machine changes between A and B. The 808's kick is a round, soft boom. The 909's starts with a hard click and a shorter, harder body that punches, and its open hi-hat is brighter. On the real 909 the hi-hats and cymbals were samples while the drums were analog circuits; both kits here are synthesized, the 909's hats included. The 909 is the machine Knuckles played under records in his DJ sets.
